rationale: Recommend no. The held Federal Register text of EO 10996 (27 FR 1521, signed February 16, 1962) states in its section 8 that it supersedes Executive Order No. 10679 of September 20, 1956, and its sections 1 to 6 restate each command; the U.S. Code note at 5 U.S.C. 5518 and the OFR catalog agree. Agreements made under EO 10679 continue under EO 10996 section 7 as independent instruments, so no command of EO 10679 survived and the order was not in force on 2026-10-14.
